description: The only capability set. Deny-by-default, scoped to the one window. Beyond core:default it grants exactly the five window verbs a custom title bar needs — minimise, maximise, close, move, resize — because the native frame is off and the app draws its own. core:window:default is READ-ONLY, so none of these came for free. Every permission here is on the reviewed allowlist in xtask/src/desktop.rs, so widening it is a visible diff to a gated file. No plugin namespace appears, and none may: shell/process/fs/http/updater/opener are refused by the same gate.
